alignments.note: Conjunction waw takes the ASV's coordinating And (rule 14).
Demonstrative subject of the verbless clause.

Construct noun is the predicate, so it carries the construction-supplied copula (rule 20). The rectum is rendered arthrously (the trespass offering), so nothing is fronted and the construct takes a supplied the (rule 29).
Article on the rectum takes the the standing before its own word (rule 29, arthrous case).
Rectum takes the relational of (rule 19); offering is the supplied generic, so the head is trespass (rule 31).
Predicate of the second verbless clause, so it takes the supplied is (rule 20); its own word is holy.

The genitive of intensity is what the ASV renders by most, so the rectum takes it under rule 19. A noncompositional reading of qodesh qodashim as most holy was available, but rule 2 prefers the split since each morpheme has an English word.
Explicit subject pronoun takes only its own English (rule 20).

review_notes: Superlative construct qodesh qodashim split as most (rectum) + holy (construct) rather than fused.
